name: SetColorInExcelWorksheet
description: The name of the worksheet to lookup range in the Excel file.
author: @gaurav

fields.name: __CredentialName__M365
fields.label: M365 Excel Credential
fields.description: The M365 Excel credential containing valid tenant ID, client ID, and client secret which is used to authenticate API requests.

fields.name: DriveAndItemId
fields.label: Drive and Item ID
fields.description: The Drive ID and Item ID of the Excel file in OneDrive or SharePoint (format: driveId/items/itemId).

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet to set color value to specific range in the Excel file.

fields.name: RangeAddress
fields.label: Range Address
fields.description: Set color to specific range address from the Excel file .

fields.name: Color
fields.label: Color
fields.description: Set Color value add to be an specified excel file

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the details of the set color range in the Excel file..
